firstLines: Pocket QA connects people who build apps with people who test them on their own devices. Every session is consented, and every result is reviewed by a person.
Test apps on your own phone
Try an app, think out loud, and tell the builder what got in your way.
Builders fund studies with test credits. Testers record consented sessions. Every reward needs approval.
Sign-in is managed by Firebase · evidence is stored privately in cloud storage
Choose how you’ll use Pocket QA.
Find studies that match your device, record consented sessions, and earn test credits when your work is approved.
Create studies, fund them with local test credits, and review testers’ evidence.
